title: Geologic Map of the Myrtle Beach 30' x 60' Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, and Wykel, C.A., 2024, Geologic Map of the Myrtle Beach 30' x 60' Quadrangle, Horry County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Map Compilation 02, map scale 1:100,000.
notes: SCGS Map Compilation 02 (Doar and Wykel, 2024), Myrtle Beach 30'x60' quadrangle, Horry County, 1:100,000; geology mapped 2012-2018. Units recorded from the description of map units; most letter symbols are not in the text layer (only dg, QHbr, QHebr, QHfw and Kp) and are not recorded. Alloformation boundary elevations (e.g. Silver Bluff 6-10 ft, Princess Anne 10-18 ft, Pamlico 17-25 ft, Ten Mile Hill 25-35 ft, Ladson 35-57 ft, Penholoway 57-75 ft, Wicomico 75-95 ft) are in the text but not stored as surfaces (they are general landward/seaward margins). Map-face drill holes (SCGS hand-auger HA-, Hydrology HoR- and SCGS 26- well logs), unit symbols and the cross section are not digitized; a re-read with images is queued. Portions of North Carolina not mapped. SUBSURFACE: cross section not digitized.
